name: Rábahídvég (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of white over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rábahídvég: a crowned blue shield with a yellow bridge and a ploughshare, above a scroll inscribed RÁBAHÍDVÉG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Rábahídvég arms with crown and scroll
